task_summary: Wipe a laboratory workbench surface from left to right, then lift a 400 g payload container at full horizontal extension and place it onto an elevated shelf.

phases.name: surface_wipe
phases.description: Horizontal sweeping motion across the lower bench surface at moderate reach.

phases.name: fast_extended_lift
phases.description: Rapid upward lift while arm extends forward to maximum moment arm with 0.4 kg payload.

phases.name: shelf_place_and_return
phases.description: Controlled placement at upper shelf height followed by retraction to home pose.

critical_moments.reason: Maximum horizontal moment arm (~0.61 m) combined with upward angular acceleration creates peak J2 shoulder pitch torque demand.
Simultaneous J2 upward pitch velocity and high gravity load pushes J2 actuator along its torque-speed derating curve.
